description: Defines a data container class 'StaffAccountSummaryCollectionData' with nested class 'LoanAccountSummary' for summarizing staff account data related to loans, including identifiers, display names, and associated loan account data.

classes.name: StaffAccountSummaryCollectionData
classes.description: A container for lists of client and group loan account summaries associated with staff.

classes.name: StaffAccountSummaryCollectionData.LoanAccountSummary
classes.description: Represents a summary of loan accounts for a specific client or group, including ID, display name, and collection of loan details.

methods.name: StaffAccountSummaryCollectionData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client and group lists.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the loan account summary.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name for the client or group.

methods.name: getLoans
methods.description: Returns the collection of loan account details.

methods.name: setLoans
methods.description: Sets the collection of loan account details.
